period_source: Default matches issue_service.LOAN_PERIOD_DAYS; configurable centrally, 1..365 days.
overdue_definition: current due timestamp earlier than current UTC timestamp; stricter than calendar-day fine accrual.
assisted_role: ADMIN only, same authorization boundary as assisted return
reservation_block_owner: Another account on same work_id, regardless of spare copies. Own/cancelled/fulfilled reservations do not block.
fees: No fee or inventory mutation on renewal. Overdue renewal is denied. Existing return fine remains UTC overdue calendar days x INR 5.
legacy_schema: Missing renewal_count treated as zero; original_due_date first saved at renewal; no broad backfill.
idempotency: Required UUID request_id + expected_due_date; receipt stored in same atomic issue update. Replay requires same actor and original expected due.
invalid_config: Fail closed; eligibility/mutation routes return structured RENEWAL_POLICY_INVALID.
assistant: Deferred: existing mutation intents and default-off pending confirmation framework untouched.
